entities.summary: National Assembly, a political institution in Venezuela during The Maduro Crisis: Collapse, Migration, and Political Standoff (2019–2025). Grew from Guaidó declares himself interim president — January 23, 2019 and Venezuelan hyperinflation reaches 1,000,000%. Led to the emergence of Edmundo González recognized by multiple nations as president-elect.
